# Sellio

> Sellio is a connected commerce platform by Apptelier for branded storefronts, ordering, merchant operations and an evolving sector-based marketplace world.

Canonical website: https://sellio.apptelier.sg/
Creator: Apptelier, Singapore
Contact: hello@apptelier.sg

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://sellio.apptelier.sg/
- Privacy Policy: https://sellio.apptelier.sg/privacy
- Terms and Conditions: https://sellio.apptelier.sg/terms

## What Sellio does

Sellio gives merchants tools for branded online storefronts, QR and table ordering, order workflows, kitchen display, products and inventory, reporting, staff roles and permissions, and AI-assisted business workflows.

Sellio World is the marketplace layer. Merchants can establish a storefront presence in relevant business districts while retaining their own brand, products, imagery and customer experience.

## Merchant plans

- Starter: SGD 79/month
- Growth: SGD 139/month
- Professional: SGD 199/month

Eligible new merchants receive a seven-day trial. Current plan details and limits are shown on the homepage and should be treated as the source of truth.

## Public storefronts

Public merchant storefronts use URLs under:
https://sellio.apptelier.sg/store/

Preview URLs, merchant administration pages, dashboards, order-management interfaces and authenticated application routes are not public reference pages and should not be treated as canonical product documentation.

## Key concepts

- Sellio storefront: a merchant-branded customer-facing commerce page.
- Sellio World: the connected marketplace and merchant discovery environment.
- Sellio Coins: in-platform rewards used for eligible marketplace progression and cosmetic customisation.
- Merchant workspace: operational tools for orders, inventory, reporting, staff access and related workflows.
